## Activity

This report covers activity at River Outreach during March 2022. A total of 47 captures were completed during the reporting period. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. It also supports monitoring of the time taken for images to proceed through the grading process. Activity is reported for the site and month specified, with results presented below in a consistent format.

## Image quality

Image quality review found that 4 captures were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 8.5. The ungradable captures are recorded separately from those that proceeded to grading, so the quality result can be considered alongside the grading outcome. The figures provide a straightforward summary of the proportion of completed captures that could not be assessed.

## Grading

Grading identified 5 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 16. This measure summarises the midpoint of the recorded wait for grading and should be read with the activity and image quality results. Together, the reported figures describe the volume of captures, the number that could not be graded, the ungradable rate, the referable findings, and the median grading lag for River Outreach in March 2022.
